articles.title: Potentially deadly bluetongue livestock virus found in Scotland for first time
articles.description: A single case of bluetongue is found in an animal on a farm in Dumfries and Galloway.

articles.title: Isle of Man 'very well placed' for solar eclipse
articles.description: The island is particularly well placed to see the celestial spectacle, sitting just outside the path of totality.

articles.title: At least 132 killed in Colombia's largest  earthquake in years
articles.description: More than 480 people were injured in the quakes, with more feared trapped under collapsed buildings.

articles.title: Perseid meteor shower reaches peak: When and where to catch a glimpse
articles.description: On Wednesday night the Perseids will peak offering the best chance of seeing a 'shooting star'.

articles.title: GB's Amy Hunt wins European 100m gold
articles.description: Britain's Amy Hunt has her "coming of age" moment as she storms to 100m glory at the European Athletics Championships in Birmingham.

articles.title: Ingebrigtsen returns from 'lowest of lows' to clinch 5,000m gold
articles.description: Jakob Ingebrigtsen fights back from "the lowest of lows" to win a stunning 5,000m gold at the European Championships after almost a year out with injury.

articles.title: Great Britain win mixed 4x400m relay silver
articles.description: Great Britain win their first medal of the 2026 European Athletics Championships, finishing second to Norway to take silver in the 4x400m mixed relay final in Birmingham.

articles.title: 'We've had a lot of close calls': Canada wildfire evacuees wonder if they still have homes
articles.description: More than 12,000 people have been forced to evacuate and some homes have been lost after a wildfire tore through Canada's picturesque Okanagan region.

articles.title: New filming guidelines used at Europeans for first time
articles.description: New guidelines advising broadcasters on more respectful camera angles at live athletics events are used at the European Athletics Championships for the first time

articles.title: Kenya bids to host 2029 World Athletics Championships
articles.description: Kenya submits a bid to host the 2029 World Athletics Championships as it seeks to become the first African nation to stage the flagship event.

articles.title: Schedule and how to follow European Athletics Championships on the BBC
articles.description: Timetable and BBC coverage times for the European Athletics Championships in Birmingham from 10-16 August.

articles.title: Lorry turns over as typhoon hits China
articles.description: Video shows a lorry being blown over after heavy rain and winds continued to batter Wenzhou, a city in China's eastern Zhejiang province.
